units.source_text: 乃木大将（乃木大将：即乃木希典（1849—1912），日本陆军大将。）殉死的消息，也是父亲看了报纸最先知道的。

en.t: The news of General Nogi's ritual suicide was also something my father first learned from reading the newspaper.
This is terrible! This is terrible!

units.source_text: 我们都毫不知情，被他这突如其来的话吓了一跳。

en.t: None of us knew anything about it, and his sudden words startled us.

units.source_text: “那时候，我还以为父亲的脑袋变得痴呆了，心里激灵一下。”

en.t: At that moment I even thought Father's mind had gone feeble, and it gave me a chill.
My elder brother told me afterward.
My sister's husband agreed as well.

units.source_text: 其实那时候的报纸上，登的全都是乡下人每天盼着看的那种新闻。

en.t: In fact, the newspapers at that time were full of the sort of news that country people waited eagerly to read every day.

units.source_text: 我坐在父亲枕边，仔细地看那天的报纸，没工夫看的时候，就悄悄拿回自己房间，一字不漏地看一遍。

en.t: I sat by Father's pillow and read that day's newspaper carefully; when I had no time to read it there, I quietly took it back to my room and went through every word.

units.source_text: 一身戎装的乃木大将，和他那位身着宫中女官盛装的夫人的身影，深深地印在我眼里。

en.t: The image of General Nogi in full military dress, together with his wife in the formal attire of a court lady, was deeply imprinted on my eyes.

units.source_text: 悲痛的风吹遍乡村的每个角落，在沉睡的草木都为之颤抖的极其悲痛的时刻，我突然接到一封先生的电报。

en.t: At that moment of profound grief, when a sorrowful wind seemed to blow through every corner of the countryside and make even the sleeping trees and grasses tremble, I suddenly received a telegram from Sensei.

units.source_text: 在那种见到穿西装的人，狗就会叫的地方，连一封电报都是件不得了的大事。

en.t: In a place where dogs barked at the sight of anyone wearing Western clothes, even a single telegram was a tremendous event.

units.source_text: 接到电报的母亲，果然很是吃惊，特意把我叫到没人的地方，

en.t: My mother, who had received the telegram, was indeed quite startled and deliberately called me aside to a place where no one else was around.
She asked, What does it say?

units.source_text: 还站在旁边等着我打开信封。

en.t: Then she stood beside me, waiting for me to open the envelope.

units.source_text: 电报的内容很简单，说是想见我一面，问我能否去东京一下。

en.t: The telegram was very simple: it said that he wanted to see me and asked whether I could come to Tokyo.
I began to think it over.

units.source_text: “一定是你托他找工作的事有了眉目。”

en.t: It must be that something has come of the job you asked him to find for you.
